name: Sprocket
desc: The frame admits it is a strip of film — perforations creep past on both edges, the lamphouse hot spot wanders across the gate, the frame line drifts through because nothing is registered, an optical soundtrack wobbles down one flank and keykode numbers print along the rebate, in print, orange-mask negative, academy, super-8 or a strip laid on a light table.

energy.doc: lamphouse gain — how hard the light drives through the gate and how much the pass emits

scale.doc: film width: 0.3 is a narrow strip on a light table with room around it, 2.4 blows the picture up until the perfs run off-frame

density.doc: edge furniture and wear — keykode, frame numbers, edge fog and dirt

track.doc: optical soundtrack amplitude (audio widens it live; it scrolls on its own regardless)

hue.doc: lamp colour temperature (38 = tungsten); the base and edge fog take their cast from it

speed.doc: transport rate — how fast the film creeps through the gate

x.doc: where the strip sits across the frame

y.doc: framing offset — slides the frame line up and down the gate

alpha.doc: master opacity of the whole pass

style.doc: which gauge is on the transport — these differ in geometry and in what the base does with light, not just in hue: a print's rebate blocks it, an orange-mask negative passes it

act.doc: multi-minute program: a steady run, a slow creep, or a reel wearing out until a splice passes and a fresh one starts

seed.doc: which reel — edge numbers, dirt and wear
